cohort: The study included 252 women (126 with cesarean section and 126 with normal deliveries) who referred to Fasa health centers after delivery in 2015.
finding: Birth rate, mother's occupation, education level, cesarean history, history of hypertension, history of stillbirth, gestational diabetes, fear of normal delivery, bleeding, delivery time, type of pregnancy, spouse's job, smoking, CPD, and NST showed a significant correlation with cesarean section.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from women who referred to Fasa health centers after delivery in 2015.
